description: This is a unit test class for the CustomerService in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, specifically testing customer-related functionalities such as saving a customer, retrieving a list of customers, and fetching a customer by ID.

classes.name: CustomerServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomerService in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, covering customer creation, retrieval, and search functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CustomerService instance and populates test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveCustomer
methods.description: Tests the saveCustomer method of CustomerDao, ensuring it saves and returns the Customer object correctly.

methods.name: testGetAllCustomer
methods.description: Tests the searchCustomers method of CustomerService to confirm it retrieves a list of Customer objects based on search filters.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Verifies that getCustomer retrieves the correct Customer object by its ID.
